Microsoft.summary:
Those results depend on an AI storage infrastructure that can match storage performance and capacity to the workload.
AI storage infrastructure must therefore provide additional tiers that balance proximity, capacity and speed, with each layer handling a different part of the data load, according to Shadley.
AI storage infrastructure brings KV cache closer to compute As context windows expand, graphics processing unit memory alone can’t hold everything an agentic workload needs during inference.

Microsoft.summary:
Key finding: exposing everything (source code, runbooks, query schemas, past investigation notes) as files and letting the agent use read_file , grep , find , and shell outperformed specialized tooling — "Intent Met" score rose from 45% to 75% on novel incidents.
Context Engineering for Reliable AI Agents: Lessons from Building Azure SRE Agent — Microsoft's account of shifting from 100+ bespoke tools and a prescriptive prompt to a filesystem-based context engineering system for their SRE agent.
Agent Harness Design: 3 Patterns for Harnessing Claude's Intelligence — Anthropic's April 2026 design guide distilling harness engineering into three actionable patterns: build on tools Claude already knows, remove harness assumptions as capabilities improve, and set UX/cost/safety boundaries carefully.

Microsoft.title: Meta Has Quietly Become One of Microsoft’s Largest AI Customers
Microsoft.titleEn: Meta Has Quietly Become One of Microsoft’s Largest AI Customers
Microsoft.titleKo: Meta는 조용히 Microsoft의 최대 AI 고객 중 하나가 됨
Microsoft.summary:
(Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc. has become one of Microsoft Corp.'s biggest AI customers, underscoring how demand for the emerging technology remains concentrated in the tech industry.
Meta is spending heavily on AI to assist its software development efforts, buying access to models through multiple platforms based on their availability and how much they cost, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
This could help Meta reduce spending on external services like those from Microsoft.
summaryLinesEn: (Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc. has become one of Microsoft Corp.'s biggest AI customers, underscoring how demand for the emerging technology remains concentrated in the tech industry.

This could help Meta reduce spending on external services like those from Microsoft.
summaryLinesKo: (Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc.는 Microsoft Corp.의 최대 AI 고객 중 하나가 되었으며, 이는 신흥 기술에 대한 수요가 여전히 기술 산업에 집중되어 있음을 강조함
이 문제에 대해 잘 아는 사람들에 따르면 Meta는 소프트웨어 개발 노력을 지원하기 위해 AI에 막대한 비용을 지출하고 있으며, 가용성과 비용에 따라 여러 플랫폼을 통해 모델에 대한 액세스를 구매하고 있음
이는 Meta가 Microsoft와 같은 외부 서비스에 대한 지출을 줄이는 데 도움이 될 수 있음

NVIDIA.summary:
In another case, the US charged three people with allegedly exporting $3.5 billion worth of AI servers to China, again by routing them through third-party countries.
Prosecutors in Taiwan just indicted nine individuals, including NVIDIA and Super Micro employees, for illegally bringing AI servers into China, Reuters reported.
In one instance , $1 billion worth of server racks may have been shipped through Southeast Asian countries like Thailand or Malaysia to circumvent US export controls.

NVIDIA.summary:
New measured performance data shows NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems deliver up to 30x higher throughput per megawatt than NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 on agentic workloads.
These early results for Vera Rubin NVL72 demonstrate NVIDIA’s accelerated pace of innovation.
At up to 35x lower cost per million tokens than GB300 NVL72, Vera Rubin NVL72 can run agents continuously, at scale, across the full breadth of customers’ workloads.

Vera Rubin NVL72의 이러한 초기 결과는 NVIDIA의 가속화된 혁신 속도를 보여줌

NVIDIA.title: How XPUs Meet a World-Class AI Factory
NVIDIA.titleEn: How XPUs Meet a World-Class AI Factory
NVIDIA.titleKo: XPU가 세계적 수준의 AI 공장을 만나는 방법
NVIDIA.summary:
Hyperscalers and AI-native companies building custom XPUs must consider not just XPU design, but the design and development of the entire AI platform, including scale-up and scale-out networking, rack-scale architecture, production factory software and a robust supplier ecosystem.
NVLink Fusion delivers on that need, connecting XPUs to NVIDIA’s world-leading AI infrastructure to increase performance, accelerate time to market and mitigate risk for semi-custom AI factories.
NVLink Fusion also includes NVIDIA NVLink-C2C for connecting XPUs to NVIDIA Vera CPUs or other ecosystem CPUs, delivering up to 6x the energy efficiency of a PCIe interface — helping remove barriers between control and compute for agentic systems.
summaryLinesEn: Hyperscalers and AI-native companies building custom XPUs must consider not just XPU design, but the design and development of the entire AI platform, including scale-up and scale-out networking, rack-scale architecture, production factory software and a robust supplier ecosystem.
NVLink Fusion delivers on that need, connecting XPUs to NVIDIA’s world-leading AI infrastructure to increase performance, accelerate time to market and mitigate risk for semi-custom AI factories.

NVLink Fusion also includes NVIDIA NVLink-C2C for connecting XPUs to NVIDIA Vera CPUs or other ecosystem CPUs, delivering up to 6x the energy efficiency of a PCIe interface — helping remove barriers between control and compute for agentic systems.
summaryLinesKo: 맞춤형 XPU를 구축하는 하이퍼스케일러 및 AI 기반 기업은 XPU 설계뿐만 아니라 수직 확장 및 수평 확장 네트워킹, 랙 규모 아키텍처, 생산 공장 소프트웨어 및 강력한 공급업체 생태계를 포함한 전체 AI 플랫폼의 설계 및 개발도 고려해야 함
NVLink Fusion은 XPU를 NVIDIA의 세계 최고의 AI 인프라에 연결하여 성능을 높이고 출시 시간을 가속화하며 반 맞춤형 AI 공장의 위험을 완화함으로써 이러한 요구를 충족함
NVLink Fusion에는 XPU를 NVIDIA Vera CPU 또는 기타 생태계 CPU에 연결하기 위한 NVIDIA NVLink-C2C도 포함되어 있어 PCIe 인터페이스의 에너지 효율성을 최대 6배까지 높여 에이전트 시스템의 제어와 컴퓨팅 사이의 장벽을 제거하는 데 도움이 됨

NVIDIA.title: Giga-Scale AI and the Ethernet Evolution: How Spectrum-X Ethernet Rewrites the Rules | NVIDIA Technical Blog
NVIDIA.titleEn: Giga-Scale AI and the Ethernet Evolution: How Spectrum-X Ethernet Rewrites the Rules | NVIDIA Technical Blog
NVIDIA.titleKo: 기가스케일 AI와 이더넷의 진화 · Spectrum-X 이더넷이 규칙을 다시 쓰는 방법 | NVIDIA 기술 블로그
NVIDIA.summary:
This allows a simple two-tier topology to scale to over 128,000 endpoints, or up to 16 million endpoints with a three-tier topology, without introducing the latency and jitter bottlenecks of a traditional multi-tier fabric topology.
To bridge this gap, NVIDIA introduced Spectrum-X Ethernet , a hardware-accelerated networking architecture designed from the ground up for giga-scale AI factories.
Demystifying Multiplane topology and Spectrum-X Multiplane technology To scale an AI factory to hundreds of thousands of GPUs, traditional networking architectures require adding additional tiers (e.g., moving from a 2-tier to a 3-tier fat-tree topology).

이러한 격차를 해소하기 위해 NVIDIA는 처음부터 기가 규모 AI 공장을 위해 설계된 하드웨어 가속 네트워킹 아키텍처인 Spectrum-X 이더넷을 도입함

NVIDIA.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
NVIDIA.titleEn: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
NVIDIA.titleKo: 엔비디아는 이제 AI 모델이 아닌 하네스가 진정한 영웅임을 보여줬음
NVIDIA.summary:
The TL;DR: Simply by using a custom harness tweaked to handle memory well and including a “supervisor” boss-like component, researchers got Claude Opus 5 to achieve a 100% score on the interactive reasoning benchmark ARC-AGI-3 — a set of 2D games with no instructions, where the model has to figure out how to play and win, similar to how a human would.
They showed that the harness needs a “supervisor” component that prods the agent in the right direction if it gets stuck.
Nvidia researchers created their own souped-up harness called the Agentic Variation Operators (AVO).
summaryLinesEn: The TL;DR: Simply by using a custom harness tweaked to handle memory well and including a “supervisor” boss-like component, researchers got Claude Opus 5 to achieve a 100% score on the interactive reasoning benchmark ARC-AGI-3 — a set of 2D games with no instructions, where the model has to figure out how to play and win, similar to how a human would.
They showed that the harness needs a “supervisor” component that prods the agent in the right direction if it gets stuck.
Nvidia researchers created their own souped-up harness called the Agentic Variation Operators (AVO).
summaryLinesKo: 요약 · 메모리를 잘 처리하도록 조정된 맞춤형 하네스를 사용하고 "감독자" 보스와 같은 구성 요소를 포함함으로써 연구원들은 Claude Opus 5가 대화형 추론 벤치마크 ARC-AGI-3에서 100% 점수를 달성하도록 함 · ARC-AGI-3은 지침이 없는 2D 게임 세트로, 모델은 인간이 하는 것과 유사하게 플레이하고 승리하는 방법을 알아내야 함
그들은 하네스가 막힐 경우 에이전트를 올바른 방향으로 안내하는 "감독자" 구성 요소가 필요하다는 것을 보여주었음
Nvidia 연구원들은 AVO(Agentic Variation Operators)라는 자체 강화 하네스를 만들었음

Apple.titleEn: Apple's M5 Ultra with an 80-core GPU will power through your AI models and 8K video - Engadget
Apple.summary:
Boosting those speeds further is a next-gen 80-core (max) GPU with a neural accelerator in each core that bumps peak AI compute 4.5 times compared to the M3 Ultra, while boosting graphics performance by 40 percent.
With all that, the M6 "delivers the world's fastest single-threaded performance and up to 1.2x faster multi-threaded performance as compared to M5," according to Apple.The company is also promising a 30 percent uplift in neural processing, along with improvements to the shader core architecture, dynamic caching and hardware-accelerated ray tracing.
The M5 Ultra supports up to 512GB of high-bandwidth unified memory with 1.2TB/s of bandwidth, up 50 percent over the M3 Ultra.

Google DeepMind.summary:
According to a recent Oxford Economics report , AI could deliver up to $6 trillion to global GDP over the next 10 years.
New data details how AI could deliver up to $6 trillion to global GDP In the coming months, we’re going to start seeing organizations and companies not just making efficiency gains, but reshaping roles and functions, inventing new products and services, and building long-term competitive advantage.
Countries like India and Indonesia have the most absolute users, while places like Singapore have some of the highest levels of per capita adoption. 29% of AI users in Singapore — versus 12% of AI users in America — are what we call “super users”: The people who can delegate whole tasks, automate daily routines, and use paid models.

Google DeepMind.title: Putting sign language AI into users’ hands
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Putting sign language AI into users’ hands
Google DeepMind.summary:
Yet this technological revolution has not reached the world’s more than 200 sign languages — and the estimated 70 million Deaf and hard of hearing people who use them.
We co-authored a joint impact report for the release of SL2T 1.0 in Gboard and Live Transcribe, transparently detailing the technology's capabilities and current limitations — a collaborative approach we plan to continue for all major sign language releases.
Similarly to how hearing users can use dictation to speak instead of typing, this feature enables Deaf users to sign to their phone anywhere they’d normally type.

Amazon.summary:
2024年Gartnerレポート によると75%の組織がモダンAPIを持たないレガシーアプリケーションを運用しており、Fortune 500企業の71%が適切なプログラムアクセス手段を持たないメインフレームシステム上でクリティカルな業務プロセスを実行している。
AIコーディング企業 Reflexは最近、 ベンチマーク調査結果を公開し 、ビジョンエージェントがあるタスクを完了するために約50万入力トークンを消費したのに対し、APIエージェントは1万2,000トークンで処理したと報告、45倍のコスト差があることを示した。
これによりアプリケーションのモダナイゼーションやAPI統合を必要とせず、Computer Visionと入力シミュレーションを通じてレガシー・デスクトップアプリケーションを操作可能になる。

Amazon.summary:
Earlier this month, Twitch Support posted on X that it added an option to opt out of "having your channel content used to train generative AI content models across Amazon."
Now, the latest class action lawsuit claims that Twitch and Amazon committed a breach of contract when the companies decided to use its streamers as "free training stock for separate commercial AI products."
Amazon isn't the only company that's been hit with a lawsuit for allegedly using content creators for AI training.

이제 최신 집단 소송에서는 Twitch와 Amazon이 자사의 스트리머를 "별도의 상업용 AI 제품을 위한 무료 교육 자료"로 사용하기로 결정했을 때 계약 위반을 저질렀다고 주장함

Amazon.title: How AWS Marketplace is using AI agents to meet the rising demand for AI agents
Amazon.titleEn: How AWS Marketplace is using AI agents to meet the rising demand for AI agents
Amazon.titleKo: AWS Marketplace가 AI 에이전트를 사용하여 증가하는 AI 에이전트 수요를 충족하는 방법
Amazon.summary:
Overall, the global agentic procurement software market was valued at $1.2 billion in 2025, and is expected to see a compound annual growth rate of 24%, reaching nearly $9 billion by 2034, according to Market Intelo projections .
"Instead of waiting for a sales representative to schedule a demo, buyers can get the information they need and explore software on their own time and at their own pace," said Pramila Srinivasan, CEO of CharmHealth.
AWS Marketplace, one of the most well-known application marketplaces catering to enterprises of all sizes, is seeing rapid growth of its stable of AI agents, along with a rising number of traditional application offerings.

"Instead of waiting for a sales representative to schedule a demo, buyers can get the information they need and explore software on their own time and at their own pace," said Pramila Srinivasan, CEO of CharmHealth.

AWS Marketplace, one of the most well-known application marketplaces catering to enterprises of all sizes, is seeing rapid growth of its stable of AI agents, along with a rising number of traditional application offerings.
summaryLinesKo: Market Intelo의 예측에 따르면 전체적으로 전 세계 대리인 조달 소프트웨어 시장의 가치는 2025년 12억 달러였으며, 연평균 성장률 24%로 2034년에는 거의 90억 달러에 이를 것으로 예상됨
CharmHealth의 CEO인 Pramila Srinivasan은 "판매 담당자가 데모 일정을 잡기를 기다리는 대신 구매자는 필요한 정보를 얻고 자신의 시간과 속도에 맞춰 소프트웨어를 탐색할 수 있음" · 라고 말함
모든 규모의 기업을 대상으로 하는 가장 잘 알려진 애플리케이션 마켓플레이스 중 하나인 AWS Marketplace는 기존 애플리케이션 제품 수가 증가하면서 안정적인 AI 에이전트가 빠르게 성장하고 있음

Amazon.title: Govern AI agent tool access with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Govern AI agent tool access with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway를 사용하여 AI 에이전트 도구 액세스 관리 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Lock down the edge, watch everything, and plan for failure.
The following diagram illustrates the minimal topology for Scope 1: Figure 2: MCP clients connect to AgentCore Gateway, Amazon Cognito issues JWTs for authentication, AgentCore Identity manages outbound credentials, and one registered target receives tool calls When you need this scope : 1–20 pilot users, low-risk tools, shadow MCP appearing.
To follow this post, you need an AWS account with permissions to create Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Amazon Cognito resources, familiarity with OAuth 2.0 and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), basic AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI) experience, and an understanding of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) .

To follow this post, you need an AWS account with permissions to create Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Amazon Cognito resources, familiarity with OAuth 2.0 and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), basic AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI) experience, and an understanding of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) .
summaryLinesKo: 가장자리를 잠그고, 모든 것을 감시하고, 실패에 대비하세요

다음 다이어그램은 범위 1의 최소 토폴로지를 보여줌 · 그림 2: MCP 클라이언트가 AgentCore Gateway에 연결되고, Amazon Cognito가 인증을 위해 JWT를 발행하고, AgentCore ID가 아웃바운드 자격 증명을 관리하고, 등록된 하나의 대상이 도구 호출을 수신함 · 이 범위가 필요한 경우 · 1~20명의 파일럿 사용자, 저위험 도구, 섀도우 MCP가 나타남

Amazon.summary:
Second, query charges on vector indexes with over 10 million vectors are now reduced by up to 80% , significantly lowering costs for running similarity search across large-scale AI, RAG, and semantic search workloads.

summaryLinesKo: 둘째, 1,000만 개 이상의 벡터가 포함된 벡터 인덱스에 대한 쿼리 요금이 이제 최대 80% 감소되어 대규모 AI, RAG 및 의미 체계 검색 워크로드 전반에 걸쳐 유사성 검색을 실행하는 데 드는 비용이 크게 절감됨

Anthropic.titleEn: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat

Anthropic.summary:
Before, you may have developed ideas for projects over time while chatting with Claude, but when it came time to actually enact the changes, you’d have to start over by telling Cowork all the details.
On Tuesday, Anthropic announced it’s merging the memory system used by chat and Claude Cowork, which means that Claude will always remember what it learned in one area, even when you’re engaging with it in another.
In less than 48 hours, your chance to save up to $300 on your tickets will end!

Anthropic.title: Anthropic Economic Index report: Economic primitives
Anthropic.titleEn: Anthropic Economic Index report: Economic primitives
Anthropic.titleKo: 인류 경제 지수 보고서 · 경제적 기본 요소
Anthropic.summary:
In our last Anthropic Economic Index Report we began tracking business adoption patterns by studying Claude usage among 1P API customers.
Data from November 2025 points to a broad-based shift back toward augmented use on Claude.ai: The share of conversations classified as augmented jumped 5pp to 52% and the share deemed automated fell 4pp to 45%.
Perhaps the most notable development for API customers was the increase in the share of transcripts associated with Office and Administrative Support related tasks, which rose 3pp in August to 13% in November 2025.
summaryLinesEn: In our last Anthropic Economic Index Report we began tracking business adoption patterns by studying Claude usage among 1P API customers.

Data from November 2025 points to a broad-based shift back toward augmented use on Claude.ai: The share of conversations classified as augmented jumped 5pp to 52% and the share deemed automated fell 4pp to 45%.

Perhaps the most notable development for API customers was the increase in the share of transcripts associated with Office and Administrative Support related tasks, which rose 3pp in August to 13% in November 2025.
summaryLinesKo: 지난 인류 경제 지수 보고서에서 우리는 1P API 고객의 Claude 사용을 연구하여 비즈니스 채택 패턴을 추적하기 시작함
2025년 11월의 데이터는 Claude.ai에서 증강 사용으로의 광범위한 전환을 나타냄 · 증강으로 분류된 대화의 비율은 5pp에서 52%로 증가했고 자동화된 것으로 간주되는 비율은 4pp에서 45%로 감소함
아마도 API 고객에게 가장 주목할만한 발전은 Office 및 관리 지원 관련 작업과 관련된 성적표의 비율이 증가한 것일 것임 · 이는 8월에 3pp 증가하여 2025년 11월에 13%로 증가함

Anthropic.title: What 81,000 people told us about the economics of AI
Anthropic.titleEn: What 81,000 people told us about the economics of AI
Anthropic.titleKo: 81,000명의 사람들이 AI의 경제학에 관해 우리에게 말한 것
Anthropic.summary:
In order to inform the public about the economic changes we’re observing with AI, our Economic Index shares what work Claude is being asked to do, and in which jobs Claude is doing the largest share of tasks.
Our recent survey of 81,000 Claude users shows that people who work in roles that are more exposed to AI have more concerns about AI-driven job displacement.
In contrast, some users sped up tasks they were already doing, like the accountant who said, “I built a tool that helps me finish a financing task in 15 minutes that used to take 2 hours.”

Our recent survey of 81,000 Claude users shows that people who work in roles that are more exposed to AI have more concerns about AI-driven job displacement.
In contrast, some users sped up tasks they were already doing, like the accountant who said, “I built a tool that helps me finish a financing task in 15 minutes that used to take 2 hours.”
summaryLinesKo: 우리가 AI를 통해 관찰하고 있는 경제적 변화를 대중에게 알리기 위해 우리의 경제 지수는 Claude가 수행하도록 요청받은 작업과 Claude가 가장 많은 작업을 수행하는 작업을 공유함
81,000명의 Claude 사용자를 대상으로 한 최근 설문조사에 따르면 AI에 더 많이 노출되는 역할에 종사하는 사람들은 AI로 인한 일자리 대체에 대해 더 많은 우려를 갖고 있는 것으로 나타남
반면 일부 사용자는 "2시간이 걸리던 자금 조달 작업을 15분 만에 완료할 수 있는 도구를 만들었습니다"라고 말한 회계사와 같이 이미 하고 있던 작업의 속도를 높였음

Anthropic.title: Introducing the Anthropic Economic Index
Anthropic.summary:
The main findings from the Economic Index’s first paper are: Today, usage is concentrated in software development and technical writing tasks.
We’d therefore expect AI to be adopted selectively for different tasks across different occupations, and that analyzing tasks—in addition to jobs as a whole—would give us a fuller picture of how AI is being integrated into the economy.
We don’t survey people on their AI use, or attempt to forecast the future; instead, we have direct data on how AI is actually being used.

Anthropic.title: Launching the Anthropic Economic Futures Programme in the UK and Europe
Anthropic.titleEn: Launching the Anthropic Economic Futures Programme in the UK and Europe
Anthropic.titleKo: 영국과 유럽에서 인류 경제 미래 프로그램 시작
Anthropic.summary:
The Anthropic Economic Index , which examines the use of Claude in the real world, reveals that AI adoption is already widespread in industries throughout the UK and Europe.
We're committed to partnering with policymakers, academics and economists across the region to prepare for the transition ahead.
The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE) Anthropic Economic Futures Symposium will gather over a hundred experts from government, academia, and civil society to discuss AI's economic impact.

Anthropic.title: Supporting ambitious external research through the Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund
Anthropic.titleEn: Supporting ambitious external research through the Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund
Anthropic.titleKo: 인류경제미래연구기금을 통해 야심 찬 외부 연구 지원
Anthropic.summary:
Based on what we learned from the Economic Futures program, and the ambition and scale we’re seeking in proposals, we won’t directly fund anything below $1 million from this fund.
We’ve always thought that it’s important to fund big external research bets; this shift will let us do so.
We’re committing $200 million to the fund to support ambitious external research on interventions to prepare society for the economic impacts of AI.

OpenAI.titleKo: 러시아는 ChatGPT를 사용하여 서방 전역에 친크렘린 이야기를 퍼뜨리는 비밀 영향력 캠페인을 진행함
OpenAI.summary:
The linked Telegram channels, however, each reached 10,000 to 20,000 followers.
OpenAI has exposed a covert Russian influence campaign that used ChatGPT to generate social media posts and disrupted it by banning a cluster of ChatGPT accounts.
The campaign's current reach stayed small, but OpenAI says the elaborate infrastructure behind it could have been scaled up over time.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI says its Jalapeño chip can power faster AI responses than the competition
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI says its Jalapeño chip can power faster AI responses than the competition
OpenAI.summary:
Even with these performance improvements, Ho said OpenAI doesn’t expect to replace its entire chip lineup with Jalapeño, saying its overall compute strategy includes “very good partners,” like Nvidia.
First introduced in June , Jalapeño is an Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) made in partnership with Broadcom.
That means the chip can provide users with “faster responses, more responsive agents, and more reliable access as the demand grows,” according to Ho.

OpenAI.title: Pew study confirms sharp rise of AI-written text on the web since ChatGPT's launch
OpenAI.titleEn: Pew study confirms sharp rise of AI-written text on the web since ChatGPT's launch
OpenAI.titleKo: Pew 연구에서는 ChatGPT 출시 이후 웹에서 AI로 작성된 텍스트가 급격히 증가했음을 확인함
OpenAI.summary:
Ad A study by Imperial College London, the Internet Archive, and Stanford University from April 2026 reached a similar conclusion, finding that roughly 35 percent of all newly published websites were fully or partly AI-generated.
Since ChatGPT launched, the share of machine-written text online has climbed sharply.
The researchers also found 33 percent higher semantic similarity between AI texts and a much more positive tone overall but cautioned that public perception of negative effects often goes well beyond what the data actually supports.

OpenAI.title: How to cancel your ChatGPT subscription (and why you might want to) - Engadget
OpenAI.titleEn: How to cancel your ChatGPT subscription (and why you might want to) - Engadget
OpenAI.titleKo: ChatGPT 구독을 취소하는 방법(및 취소하려는 이유) - Engadget
OpenAI.summary:
After OpenAI's February 2026 agreement with the US Department of Defense to deploy its models on the department's classified network, Sensor Tower data reported by TechCrunch showed US ChatGPT app uninstalls jumping 295 percent day over day .
Spending less doesn't necessarily require giving up a paid plan altogether.
If you have lost access to the ChatGPT account or its email address, OpenAI support can also cancel the subscription after locating the account using the email address, the last four digits of the payment card and the date of the most recent payment.

OpenAI.summary:
OpenAI is previewing transparent background support for GPT-Image-2 through its API.
According to OpenAI, baking the alpha channel in during generation produces better results than conventional background removal, especially on tricky areas like transparent glass or thin fibers.
OpenAI recommends leaving background descriptions out of the prompt, since the model may still generate one otherwise.

SpaceX (xAI, Cursor).summary:
Anthropic PBC expects to match or beat the size of SpaceX ’s record-setting initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, in the latest sign of overwhelming demand from investors looking to profit from the artificial intelligence boom.
Anthropic’s target reflects how the AI industry’s leaders are transforming the tech investment landscape in a very short time.
The Claude developer is running the numbers as it prepares to file publicly for its potential mega-IPO as soon as the end of this month, the people said.

SpaceX (xAI, Cursor).summary:
There are ongoing discussions about working together, including potentially arranging for Cognition to use SpaceX’s computing capacity, said the people, who spoke on condition of anonymity as the information is not public.
SpaceX approached artificial intelligence coding startup Cognition AI Inc. about a potential acquisition, according to people familiar with the matter, in what would have been its second large takeover in recent months to gain ground in the AI race.
Cognition didn’t engage with the takeover approach, one person said.

SpaceX (xAI, Cursor).summary:
SpaceX, which merged with Elon Musk's AI company xAI earlier this year, paid $60 billion for the purchase.
In its announcement , Cursor said that it will now have access to "the largest fleet of GPUs in the world," which will give it the computing capacity to build and train better models that it can offer its customers at a lower cost.
The companies announced the acquisition in June, but the process apparently started in April, when they teamed up for Cursor's model training efforts.

Databricks.titleEn: Databricks Document Intelligence: pushing the frontier for complex document extraction | Databricks Blog

Databricks.summary:
Today, Databricks Document Intelligence helps thousands of customers put their data to work, turning billions of pages into structured data that powers production pipelines , agents , and applications .
Across six complex document benchmarks, Precision Mode beats the next best frontier model by seven points on accuracy.
A lease whose page-1 renewal terms depend on a clause on page 80, or an agreement whose page-150 paragraph redefines a term from page 3.

Databricks.title: Smart Routing in Unity AI Gateway: Match frontier quality with 30%+ lower cost per task | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Smart Routing in Unity AI Gateway: Match frontier quality with 30%+ lower cost per task | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Unity AI Gateway의 스마트 라우팅 · 작업당 비용을 30% 이상 절감하여 최전선 품질을 일치시킵니다 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
The results speak for themselves: On internal coding workloads, Smart Routing outperformed any single model at just 65% of the cost per task of a leading model like Opus 5.
That’s why we’re launching the next major cost control in Unity AI Gateway: Smart Routing, now available in Beta.
How we built task-aware routing across models and harnesses to cut costs on real-world coding tasks at Databricks by Ankit Mathur , Ivan Zhou , Bryan Qiu , Rohit Agrawal , Elise Gonzales and Kelly Albano The price and performance frontier for coding tasks features a huge diversity of models and harnesses: in 2026 alone, we’ve seen 33 new models released.

이것이 바로 Unity AI Gateway의 차세대 주요 비용 관리 기능인 스마트 라우팅을 출시하는 이유임 · 현재 베타 버전으로 제공됨

Perplexity.titleKo: Perplexity의 무료 AI 제공으로 인도에서는 수백만 명의 사용자가 늘어났음
Perplexity.summary:
In July 2025, Perplexity partnered with Airtel, India’s second biggest telecom operator, to offer a free 12-month Perplexity Pro subscription, normally worth about $200, to the Indian carrier’s 360 million customers.
In the week before the Airtel offer launched, Perplexity averaged about 11,200 downloads a day in India, per Appfigures.
Perplexity’s AI giveaway had an immediate impact, as it saw 5.9 million app downloads in India in July 2025, according to data Sensor Tower shared with TechCrunch.

Airtel 제품이 출시되기 전 주에 Perplexity는 AppFigures 기준 인도에서 하루 평균 약 11,200건의 다운로드를 기록함
TechCrunch와 공유된 Sensor Tower 데이터에 따르면 Perplexity의 AI 경품 행사는 2025년 7월 인도에서 590만 건의 앱 다운로드를 기록하는 등 즉각적인 영향을 미쳤음

Mistral AI.title: The Mistral paradox: Europe’s push for tech sovereignty relies on China’s Z.ai
Mistral AI.titleEn: The Mistral paradox: Europe’s push for tech sovereignty relies on China’s Z.ai
Mistral AI.titleKo: 미스트랄 역설 · 유럽의 기술 주권 추진은 중국의 Z.ai에 달려 있음
Mistral AI.summary:
Despite a deluge of political chatter about creating a sovereign European AI offering, the bloc has lagged both the US and China in investment and innovation.
Geoeconomics expert Shahin Vallee from the German Council on Foreign Relations said that a pivot to “AI adoption rather than innovation” therefore represented “the right strategy for Mistral and for Europe”.
AI race contender’s decision to offer GLM-5.2 a sign of how European political and commercial incentives can pull in different directions Mistral’s model of choice is GLM-5.2, an open-weight large language model developed by Zhipu, also known as Z.ai, one of China’s six “AI tiger” companies, included since 2025 on the US’ entity list because of national security concerns regarding military modernisation.
summaryLinesEn: Despite a deluge of political chatter about creating a sovereign European AI offering, the bloc has lagged both the US and China in investment and innovation.

Geoeconomics expert Shahin Vallee from the German Council on Foreign Relations said that a pivot to “AI adoption rather than innovation” therefore represented “the right strategy for Mistral and for Europe”.

AI race contender’s decision to offer GLM-5.2 a sign of how European political and commercial incentives can pull in different directions Mistral’s model of choice is GLM-5.2, an open-weight large language model developed by Zhipu, also known as Z.ai, one of China’s six “AI tiger” companies, included since 2025 on the US’ entity list because of national security concerns regarding military modernisation.
summaryLinesKo: 주권적인 유럽 AI 제품을 만드는 것에 대한 정치적인 논의가 쇄도하고 있음에도 불구하고 이 블록은 투자와 혁신에서 미국과 중국 모두에 뒤쳐졌음
독일 외교협회의 지구경제학 전문가 샤힌 발레(Shahin Vallee)는 “혁신보다는 AI 채택”으로의 전환이 “미스트랄과 유럽을 위한 올바른 전략”을 의미한다고 말함
GLM-5.2를 제공하기로 한 AI 경쟁 경쟁자의 결정은 유럽의 정치적, 상업적 인센티브가 어떻게 다른 방향으로 나아갈 수 있는지 보여주는 신호임 · Mistral이 선택한 모델은 Zhipu가 개발한 개방형 대형 언어 모델인 GLM-5.2임 · Z.ai라고도 알려져 있으며, 군사 현대화에 대한 국가 안보 문제로 인해 2025년부터 미국 기업 목록에 포함됨

Sierra AI.title: Sophisticated agents for the most demanding companies: Sierra launches in Korea
Sierra AI.titleEn: Sophisticated agents for the most demanding companies: Sierra launches in Korea
Sierra AI.titleKo: 가장 까다로운 기업을 위한 정교한 에이전트 · Sierra 한국 출시
Sierra AI.summary:
Sierra is the fastest growing customer facing AI platform, and we partner with one in three of the world’s leading banks, 40% of the Fortune 50, and companies as diverse as Singtel, SoftBank, LINE MAN Wongnai, Santander, Uber, Hyatt, Gap, Wilson and Sonos.
BBVA, a leading global bank, launched Sierra’s first long running Horizon agent in just 30 days, serving customers in Spain and Argentina.
Agents built on Sierra are now moving beyond support — account sign-up and set-up, password resets, troubleshooting, returns, replacing an IVR — to driving key business workflows.

Sierra AI.titleEn: Release governance: guardrails for agents at scale
Sierra AI.titleKo: 릴리스 거버넌스 · 대규모 에이전트를 위한 가드레일
Sierra AI.summary:
If you’ve upgraded your model, redesigned authentication, or made a sweeping behavioral change, you can verify the release behaves as expected before rolling it out more broadly.
That’s why we introduced merge approval workflows .
Checks are prioritized by severity, helping teams distinguish issues likely to impact customers from lower-priority quality improvements, and most come with a suggested fix from Ghostwriter that can be applied in place.

Sierra AI.title: Defense in depth in the age of agents
Sierra AI.titleEn: Defense in depth in the age of agents
Sierra AI.summary:
Supervisors catch nuance that fixed rules can’t, but as agents themselves they share some of the limitations they’re built to detect.
Other threats involve bad content that should never appear in a conversation, regardless of who introduced it.
The basic idea of defense in depth — that you need layers — is the same, but agents change what those layers do.

This allows a simple two-tier topology to scale to over 128,000 endpoints, or up to 16 million endpoints with a three-tier topology, without introducing the latency and jitter bottlenecks of a traditional multi-tier fabric topology.

Hugging Face.summary:
We don't always need to rely on Inference Providers or existing Gradio Spaces.
We usually wire these steps together in Python, and the moment something looks off we go back to print-debugging to find which step produced the odd value. gr.Workflow , built right into Gradio, makes the pipeline the interface .
But an fn node is just Python, which means it can also run a model inside the Space on a GPU.

Hugging Face.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: a compressed, 4-bit model that outperforms its full-precision original
Hugging Face.titleEn: Quantization-Aware Healing: a compressed, 4-bit model that outperforms its full-precision original
Hugging Face.titleKo: 양자화 인식 치유 · 전체 정밀도 원본보다 성능이 뛰어난 압축된 4비트 모델
Hugging Face.summary:
The idea that a 4-bit model can actually outperform the full-precision version turns the usual assumption about quantization completely upside down....
Our latest paper, Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs , asks a question that the field has mostly left open: once a model has already been through structural compression, not just quantization, how well does that recovery step actually work, and what is the right way to do it?
Turning a heavily compressed 4-bit model into something that can outperform its larger full-precision counterpart is the kind of result that makes you rethink what "compression" actually means.

최신 논문인 Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs에서는 해당 분야가 대부분 열려 있는 질문을 던짐 · 모델이 이미 양자화뿐만 아니라 구조적 압축을 거친 후에는 해당 복구 단계가 실제로 얼마나 잘 작동하며 이를 수행하는 올바른 방법은 무엇입니까
심하게 압축된 4비트 모델을 더 큰 전체 정밀도 모델보다 뛰어난 성능을 발휘할 수 있는 것으로 바꾸는 것은 "압축"이 실제로 무엇을 의미하는지 다시 생각하게 만드는 결과임

Hugging Face.title: Granite 4.2 LLMs: How They're Built
Hugging Face.summary:
Granite 4.2 models are built on a decoder-only dense transformer architecture with the following core components: Attention: Grouped Query Attention (GQA) with 40 attention heads and 8 KV heads Position Embedding: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) with θ = 10,000,000 Embeddings: Separate input/output embeddings (not tied) Granite 4.2 is trained from scratch on approximately 15 trillion tokens using a five-phase training strategy.
Each phase uses a distinct data mixture and learning-rate schedule, gradually shifting from broad web-scale data toward more curated, high-quality sources.
Every model can produce a chain of thought before its answer and can run in thinking or non-thinking mode depending on how much deliberation a task needs.

Hugging Face.title: Hugging Face has been fielding M&A interest for a deal worth at least $13 billion
Hugging Face.titleEn: Hugging Face has been fielding M&A interest for a deal worth at least $13 billion
Hugging Face.titleKo: 허깅페이스(Hugging Face)는 최소 130억 달러 규모의 M&A에 관심을 가져왔음
Hugging Face.summary:
Following Stripe's agreement to buy AI model marketplace startup OpenRouter for around $8 billion, interest in Hugging Face suggests investors are increasingly willing to pay premium prices for companies at the center of the AI ecosystem even if they aren't building the models themselves.
Hugging Face, whose platform helps developers discover, share, and build AI models, has been exploring a sale that could value the company at $13 billion or more.
The startup has been working with a bank to evaluate bidders' interest, and no deal has been reached yet, according to people familiar with the matter.

Hugging Face, whose platform helps developers discover, share, and build AI models, has been exploring a sale that could value the company at $13 billion or more.
The startup has been working with a bank to evaluate bidders' interest, and no deal has been reached yet, according to people familiar with the matter.
summaryLinesKo: Stripe가 AI 모델 마켓플레이스 스타트업인 OpenRouter를 약 80억 달러에 인수하기로 합의한 이후, Hugging Face에 대한 관심은 투자자들이 모델을 직접 구축하지 않더라도 AI 생태계의 중심에 있는 기업에 프리미엄 가격을 기꺼이 지불하려는 의지가 점점 더 커지고 있음을 시사함
개발자가 AI 모델을 발견, 공유 및 구축하는 데 도움이 되는 플랫폼을 제공하는 Hugging Face는 회사 가치를 130억 달러 이상으로 평가할 수 있는 매각을 모색해 왔음
이 문제에 정통한 소식통에 따르면 스타트업은 입찰자의 관심도를 평가하기 위해 은행과 협력해 왔지만 아직 합의에 이르지 못했다고 함

Activation should be boring 3 months ago, we started a revival of Papers with Code (see also the announcement tweet ).

Hugging Face.title: Measuring benchmark optimization in speech recognition
Hugging Face.titleEn: Measuring benchmark optimization in speech recognition
Hugging Face.summary:
Six of the 11 models we tested reproduced the benchmark's erroneous transcript—giving the "expected" answer even though it contradicted the audio.
Trimming away surrounding benchmark context, or appending ordinary conversational audio, can also restore the faithful transcript.
This suggests that the models are responding to acoustic cues that help them identify the benchmark membership and thus produce the expected transcript even if it contradicts the audio.

Hugging Face.titleEn: Up to 3.2x Faster Inference with LFM2.5-DSpark
Hugging Face.titleKo: LFM2.5-DSpark를 통해 최대 3.2배 더 빠른 추론 속도
Hugging Face.summary:
How does DSpark work Training and Architecture Quality parity Inference Speed Up on CPU and GPU How to use LFM2.5-DSpark Get Started Citation Today, we release DSpark draft model checkpoints for three models from our LFM2.5 family: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct, LFM2.5-2.6B, and LFM2.5-8B-A1B.
Toward on-device agentic inference : cuts function-calling latency by 57% on average for LFM2.5-2.6B Day-one support for llama.cpp and SGLang : LFM-compatible DSpark integration is open-sourced upstream The decode phase in LLM inference is traditionally memory-bound.
These add a speculative decoding path that trades a minimal memory increase for a large decoding speedup without changing output quality: Faster inference : up to 3.18 throughput improvement on a GPU and up to 2.87x on-device.

What late interaction adds is that it does so without giving up the other direction: when an exact match is what matters (a product code, a surname, a function name), MaxSim still has that token sitting there on its own, where a single-vector model had to average it in with everything else.
PyLate comes up throughout this post, so briefly: Sentence Transformers handled dense and sparse models but not late interaction, so LightOn built PyLate on top of it to close that gap, adding the training, inference, and retrieval pieces these models need.
For ColPali-style visual document retrieval, you also need the image dependencies (see Installation for all extras, and Multimodal Embedding & Reranker Models for multimodal support in general): Sentence Transformers v6.0 requires transformers v5.x, torch 2.2+, and huggingface-hub v1.x.

summaryLinesKo: 후기 상호 작용이 추가하는 점은 다른 방향을 포기하지 않고 그렇게 한다는 것임 · 정확한 일치가 중요한 경우(제품 코드, 성, 기능 이름) MaxSim은 여전히 해당 토큰을 자체적으로 보유하고 있으며 단일 벡터 모델은 다른 모든 것과 평균을 내야 함
PyLate는 이 게시물 전반에 걸쳐 매우 간략하게 나옴 · Sentence Transformer는 조밀하고 희박한 모델을 처리했지만 늦은 상호 작용은 처리하지 않았기 때문에 LightOn은 그 위에 PyLate를 구축하여 이러한 격차를 줄이고 이러한 모델에 필요한 훈련, 추론 및 검색 부분을 추가함
ColPali 스타일의 시각적 문서 검색을 위해서는 이미지 종속성도 필요합니다(일반적인 다중 모드 지원에 대해서는 모든 추가 항목에 대한 설치 및 다중 모드 임베딩 및 순위 조정 모델 참조) · Sentence Transformers v6.0에는 변환기 v5.x, 토치 2.2+ 및 Huggingface-hub v1.x가 필요함

Writer.title: WRITER Named a Market Shaper in the July 2026 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™ for AI Agents for Marketing — Startup Vendors
Writer.titleEn: WRITER Named a Market Shaper in the July 2026 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™ for AI Agents for Marketing — Startup Vendors
Writer.titleKo: 작가는 2026년 7월 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™에서 마케팅용 AI 에이전트 부문의 Market Shaper로 선정됨 · — 스타트업 공급업체
Writer.summary:
According to Gartner, “Market Shapers are ushering in a new era of industrialized, autonomous revenue engines, combining enterprise-grade governance, compliance and data security with frontier AI innovation, empowering marketing teams to move beyond pilots to scalable, autonomous agent orchestration as the new standard for modern GTM execution.”
WRITER believes it is at the forefront of this shift, combining powerful agent capabilities with an enterprise-grade platform that turns an organization’s expertise into shared infrastructure the whole team can use, connects go-to-market work, and keeps outputs on-brand, compliant, and supervised as agentic AI scales.
In WRITER’s view, the report captures a critical moment as marketing and revenue teams move beyond automating isolated tasks to reshape the customer journey itself – a shift that requires more than capable models or copilots that make individuals faster.

WRITER believes it is at the forefront of this shift, combining powerful agent capabilities with an enterprise-grade platform that turns an organization’s expertise into shared infrastructure the whole team can use, connects go-to-market work, and keeps outputs on-brand, compliant, and supervised as agentic AI scales.

In WRITER’s view, the report captures a critical moment as marketing and revenue teams move beyond automating isolated tasks to reshape the customer journey itself – a shift that requires more than capable models or copilots that make individuals faster.
summaryLinesKo: Gartner에 따르면, "Market Shapers는 엔터프라이즈급 거버넌스, 규정 준수 및 데이터 보안을 최첨단 AI 혁신과 결합하여 산업화되고 자율적인 수익 엔진의 새로운 시대를 열고 있으며, 마케팅 팀이 파일럿을 넘어 현대 GTM 실행의 새로운 표준으로 확장 가능한 자율 에이전트 오케스트레이션으로 이동할 수 있도록 지원함"
WRITER는 강력한 에이전트 기능을 엔터프라이즈급 플랫폼과 결합하여 조직의 전문 지식을 팀 전체가 사용할 수 있는 공유 인프라로 전환하고, 출시 작업을 연결하고, 에이전트 AI 규모에 따라 브랜드에 맞는 출력을 유지하고 규정을 준수하며 감독하는 엔터프라이즈급 플랫폼을 결합하여 이러한 변화의 최전선에 있다고 믿음
WRITER의 관점에서 보고서는 마케팅 및 수익 팀이 격리된 작업을 자동화하는 것에서 벗어나 고객 여정 자체를 재구성하는 중요한 순간을 포착함 · 이러한 변화에는 개인을 더 빠르게 만드는 유능한 모델이나 부조종사 이상의 것이 필요함

Writer.title: How to show up where AI is listening: Building AI visibility from buyer conversations
Writer.titleEn: How to show up where AI is listening: Building AI visibility from buyer conversations
Writer.titleKo: AI가 듣고 있는 곳에 표시하는 방법 · 구매자 대화를 통해 AI 가시성 구축
Writer.summary:
You’re building content from the exact language they use, at the speed your buyers expect, in the voice your market recognizes.
It means deciding which questions matter most, building PR and communications around those questions, showing up in the social and review platforms AI reads, and making sure your story is consistent across every surface where AI forms an opinion about your brand.
Marketbridge analyzed more than 17,000 AI citations across multiple industries and reached the same conclusion: “Organizations that treat GEO as a technical add-on risk missing the bigger picture.”

summaryLinesKo: 귀하는 구매자가 기대하는 속도와 시장이 인식하는 목소리로 구매자가 사용하는 정확한 언어로 콘텐츠를 구축하고 있음
이는 어떤 질문이 가장 중요한지 결정하고, 해당 질문을 중심으로 PR 및 커뮤니케이션을 구축하고, AI가 읽는 소셜 및 리뷰 플랫폼에 표시하고, AI가 브랜드에 대한 의견을 형성하는 모든 표면에서 스토리가 일관되도록 하는 것을 의미함
Marketbridge는 여러 업계에 걸쳐 17,000개 이상의 AI 인용을 분석한 결과 다음과 같은 동일한 결론에 도달함 · "GEO를 기술적 추가 기능으로 취급하는 조직은 더 큰 그림을 놓칠 위험이 있음"

Writer.summary:
Together, the upgrades allow marketing and revenue teams to confidently scale their most ambitious agentic workflows in production without token costs holding them back.
New governance tools to control spend and scale what works WRITER also launched a major upgrade to reporting and governance controls that gives leaders a clear view into the agentic workflows being used across their teams.
X6 delivered the best combination of capability and cost among the models WRITER tested, scoring an average of 0.87 (out of 1.00) across all nine evaluations at $2 per million input tokens and $8 per million output tokens, ahead of Claude Opus 4.8 (0.86 at $15/$75 per million), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (0.85 at $3/$15), GPT-5.5 (0.80 at $5/$15) and Gemini 3.1 (0.77 at $2.50/$10).
summaryLinesEn: Together, the upgrades allow marketing and revenue teams to confidently scale their most ambitious agentic workflows in production without token costs holding them back.

summaryLinesKo: 업그레이드를 통해 마케팅 및 수익 팀은 토큰 비용을 부담하지 않고도 프로덕션에서 가장 야심 찬 에이전트 워크플로우를 자신있게 확장할 수 있음
지출을 제어하고 효과를 확장하는 새로운 거버넌스 도구 WRITER는 또한 리더들이 팀 전체에서 사용되는 에이전트 워크플로에 대한 명확한 보기를 제공하는 보고 및 거버넌스 제어에 대한 주요 업그레이드를 출시함

X6는 WRITER가 테스트한 모델 중 최고의 성능과 비용 조합을 제공하여 입력 토큰 백만 달러당 2달러 및 출력 토큰 백만 달러당 8달러로 9개 평가에서 평균 0.87점(1.00점 만점)을 얻었음 · 이는 Claude Opus 4.8(백만 달러당 15/75달러에서 0.86), Claude Sonnet 4.6(3달러/15달러에서 0.85), GPT-5.5를 앞섰음 · ($5/$15에서 0.80) 및 Gemini 3.1($2.50/$10에서 0.77)

Writer.title: WRITER raises $100 million in Series B to deliver on generative AI for enterprises
Writer.titleEn: WRITER raises $100 million in Series B to deliver on generative AI for enterprises
Writer.titleKo: WRITER, 기업용 생성 AI 제공을 위해 시리즈 B에서 1억 달러 모금
Writer.summary:
I’m excited to announce that WRITER has raised $100 million in Series B funding!
Here are just a few examples of how customers create, analyze, and govern with WRITER to achieve significant business impact: 6sense increased their writing output by 50% and achieves 100% brand compliance on written content.
“We believe that generative AI usage within enterprises is hitting an inflection point, and WRITER stands out to us as a leader in providing a full stack and secure platform to deliver on AI’s incredible promise.”

Here are just a few examples of how customers create, analyze, and govern with WRITER to achieve significant business impact: 6sense increased their writing output by 50% and achieves 100% brand compliance on written content.

“We believe that generative AI usage within enterprises is hitting an inflection point, and WRITER stands out to us as a leader in providing a full stack and secure platform to deliver on AI’s incredible promise.”
summaryLinesKo: WRITER가 시리즈 B 자금으로 1억 달러를 모금했다는 소식을 발표하게 되어 기쁨
다음은 고객이 WRITER를 사용하여 상당한 비즈니스 효과를 달성하기 위해 생성, 분석 및 관리하는 방법에 대한 몇 가지 예임 · 6sense는 글쓰기 출력을 50% 증가시키고 서면 콘텐츠에 대해 100% 브랜드 준수를 달성함
"우리는 기업 내에서 생성적 AI 사용이 변곡점에 도달했다고 믿고 있으며, WRITER는 AI의 놀라운 약속을 이행하기 위한 풀 스택 및 보안 플랫폼을 제공하는 리더로서 우리에게 두각을 나타내고 있음"

Writer.title: New at WRITER: Agentic work that scales without blowing the budget
Writer.titleEn: New at WRITER: Agentic work that scales without blowing the budget
Writer.titleKo: WRITER의 새로운 기능 · 예산을 초과하지 않고 확장되는 에이전트 작업
Writer.summary:
At the same time, enterprises are losing control of AI spend, burning through annual AI budgets in a matter of months and spending up to $500 million a month on uncapped AI.
The shift is from piloting agents to running them in production, across thousands of employees, with spend governed and aligned to ROI instead of left uncapped.
It’s engineered for the work most teams run every day: the high-volume personalization, research, and content work where marketing and sales teams need to scale without the bill running away.

Meta AI.titleKo: Meta의 유료 AI 에이전트 Hatch가 곧 출시되며, 10월에는 Watermelon이라는 새 모델이 출시될 예정임
Meta AI.summary:
Meta Platforms will launch its AI agent Hatch in the coming weeks and release a new AI model called Watermelon in October.
Hatch is designed to tap into sites like DoorDash, Etsy, Reddit, Yelp, and Outlook, and to offer a customizable dashboard with features like a fitness tracker or trip planner.
Whether Watermelon becomes part of the Muse model family or ships as a standalone model is still unclear.

The setting makes it so your activity off Meta's platforms doesn't inform your ad experience rather than shutting down all ad personalization.
Because Meta is introducing the setting by country, some accounts may still show Ad preferences > Ad settings > Activity information from ad partners instead.
You can keep Instagram from using your activity outside the app to influence the ads you get.

Meta AI.title: Meta Has Quietly Become One of Microsoft’s Largest AI Customers
Meta AI.titleEn: Meta Has Quietly Become One of Microsoft’s Largest AI Customers
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta는 조용히 Microsoft의 최대 AI 고객 중 하나가 됨
Meta AI.summary:
(Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc. has become one of Microsoft Corp.'s biggest AI customers, underscoring how demand for the emerging technology remains concentrated in the tech industry.
Meta is spending heavily on AI to assist its software development efforts, buying access to models through multiple platforms based on their availability and how much they cost, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
This could help Meta reduce spending on external services like those from Microsoft.
